description: Canonical high-risk fabrication / uncontracted-commitment markers for the outbound provenance gate (ADR 0028 Tier-1, universal across verticals). This file is the SINGLE source of truth: the hermes-smd-overlay vendors a copy and a CI hash-check asserts the bytes match this artifact at its pinned SHA, so the two repos cannot drift. Derived from the CLAUDE.md 'No fabricated client-facing content' Pattern A/B rule and the Tone & Positioning style markers. Match `literal_ci` and `regex` case-insensitively; `literal` exactly.

Conduct floor (ss-console#2552): the Operator speaks about what it will do, never about what it holds on you. It must not volunteer that a preference was recorded, where it lives, or that a profile exists. Triggered by a live confirm email reading 'That preference is recorded to your profile'. Storage itself is trust-contracted (ADR 0048); narrating it is the defect. Nouns are scoped to profile/preferences deliberately: 'your file' and 'your record' carry heavy legitimate legal usage ('We have added your medical records to your file') and matching them false-positives on attributed firm prose. Asked directly what is known about them, the Operator answers in full: this bans volunteering, not disclosure.
